scientific_integrity: A rational, all-arm-number homology theorem proved by an exact reduced-chain-complex kernel calculation. Standalone finite modular computations are independent consistency checks, not an infinite-family or characteristic-zero proof. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify integral torsion, integral equivariant lattices, cup products, geometric representative bases, ordered configurations, or homology at other particle weights; novelty remains subject to undiscovered equivalent literature.
title: Pole-interchange parity and Schur modules in four-particle generalized-theta homology
